description: This PHP source file handles the process of merging duplicate records in the vtiger CRM system. It includes logic for saving merged records, transferring related data, and rendering the merge interface with duplicate record details.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template handling class, instantiated to render the interface for record merging.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from duplicates to the primary record during merge.

methods.name: DeleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes a record based on provided parameters, used during merge cleanup.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab of the current module.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for specific actions on records.

methods.name: getRecordValues
methods.description: Fetches values of records for display and merge operations.
